Definition: middle voice from G575 and G5021; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce:--bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to say goodbye, to take leave, and by extension to renounce. Jesus says no one can be His disciple without forsaking all he has, a would-be follower asks first to go and bid farewell to his family, Paul takes his leave of the brothers at Corinth, and Jesus sends the crowd away to pray alone.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe farewell is the shape of discipleship. Following Jesus means loosening our grip on everything else, and sometimes the goodbye is the proof that we mean it.
